item.title: 11 Years Ago Today, The Guy She Told You Not To Worry About Stepped Into The Picture
item.description: You vs. The Guy She Told You Not to Worry About is a series of captioned images comparing two male subjects or fictional characters side-by-side, with the one on the right being the more desirable suitor of the two. In August 2016, the meme spawned hundreds of iterations after going viral on Twitter.

item.title: It's Been Nine Years Since Mom Found The Piss Drawer
item.description: Piss Drawer refers to a viral image of a 3-year old boy in a Batman costume crying because his mother found the drawer he had been urinating in. The image attracted media coverage and later became the subject of image macros and video remixes.

item.title: Two Goats Named 'Nagi' And 'Pokke' Have Been Hired To Clear An Overgrown Lot In Japan
item.description:
Nagi and Pokke are two goats in Japan deployed by Japan Rail to eat the overgrown grass near a train station in a lot in Yotsuya, an area in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

News of the railway company hiring Nagi and Pokke went viral in late October 2026. The news inspired reactions, memes and discourse online.

item.title: Ethan Klein Cheating Controversy Explodes Across Social Media
item.description:
Ethan Klein Cheating Controversy refers to a recent development in which Ethan Klein of the husband-and-wife duo h3h3productions was publicly revealed to have been having an affair by his wife Hila, culminating in an indefinite hiatus of the H3 Podcast.

The controversy began on October 22nd, 2026, when Ethan announced that the H3 Podcast was going on an indefinite hiatus. Shortly afterward, Hila published a series of statements on Instagram accusing her husband of having an affair lasting more than six months.

News of the affair spread rapidly across the internet, with prominent content creators and social media users commenting on the situation and the future of H3 and Ethan Klein's career.
